documents.title: User stories — SPEC V2 — the organisational operating model
documents.body:
# User stories — SPEC V2 — the organisational operating model

## Personas

- **The sponsoring group / owner** — adopts the V2 model and its decision register; the arbiter for the D-decisions (D56–D60 at landing).
- **The programme manager / PMO lead** — sequences the T-slices, runs the tranches, and owns the plan spine (T1).
- **The solution architect / programme architect** — uses the ownership matrix (§10.1), the seams (§10.2) and the ADM capability (T9) to keep one record per fact.
- **The delivery project lead** — takes one T-slice from §12 as its contract, proves it locally with compose, real Postgres and integration tests before CI, and reports against its gate.
- **The tenant operator** — drives every V2 destination in `apps/web`, reading live rows and writing only through the action registry (§10.4).
- **The public reader** — reads the design pack at `/design/`, the programme's public site and reviewed reference.
- **The meta-job roles — PM, kanban coach, kata, operations** — run on the same catalogue, card, run and approval primitives (P6).

## Stories

- As the sponsoring group, I want the V2 organisational model as one reviewed document, so that jobs, cards, approvals and runs are defined before any slice builds them.
- As the programme manager, I want the T-slice set with a gate per slice and typed dependencies, so that T0–T3 plus T13 are sequenced for the first three months and T12 is the loop's acceptance.
- As the architect, I want the four units and the ownership matrix, so that no concept is stored twice and a contract test can enforce each seam.
- As a delivery lead, I want each slice's gate written as observable behaviour — a refused self-approval, a stale binding's `409 job_binding_stale`, a benefit profile refused without baseline, target, method and owner — so that "done" is measurable, not opinion.
- As the tenant operator, I want every write to be an `ActionSpec` (one declaration → HTTP + MCP + OpenAPI + generated client), so that the app and the agent front end share one registry.
- As the sponsoring group, I want a meeting defined as a decision forum over the four units — never a fifth record — so that decisions stay in one store.
- As the public reader, I want the hard invariants P1–P11 published with an enforcement per principle, so that the programme's claims are inspectable.
- As the sponsoring group, I want decisions D56–D60 and open questions Q17–Q20 recorded with owners, so that the review's outcome is durable.

## Scenarios

- Given the document was authored at blob `c5567f8` on `lane/spec-v2`, when the PR's file list is read, then it changes exactly one file, `docs/SPEC_V2.md`, adding 1,538 lines and deleting none.
- Given merged main, when the section list is counted, then the document has 18 top-level sections — §1–§15 plus Appendices A–C.
- Given §15.1, when read, then D56–D60 are present with their rulings; given §15.2, when read, then open questions 17–20 are present and owned.
- Given §12, when a slice is read, then it names its gate and its place in the dependency chain (T0 → T1 → T2 → T3; T13 after T2; T12 after all).
- Given a slice that is called done, when the record is read, then it was proved locally before CI, and CI ran when the slice integrated and when the repo merged.
- Given the design pack at `/design/`, when a page is read, then it is evidence of intent only: the implementation is the app's route, and no production screen renders a fixture (D64).

## Verify

- `git show origin/main:docs/SPEC_V2.md | grep -c '^## '` → 18 top-level sections.
- `git show origin/main:docs/SPEC_V2.md | grep -cE 'D5[6-9]|D60'` ≥ 5.
- `git show origin/main:docs/SPEC_V2.md | sed -n '/^## 15\./,/^## Appendix A/p' | grep -cE '\b(17|18|19|20)\b'` ≥ 4.
- The reviewed blob `c5567f8` measured 1,538 lines and 18 sections (issue #24, measured 2026-11-11).
- The landing PR's file list recorded on #24: one file, `+1538 -0`, docs-only.
- The review record on v1 PR #36 (archived): a deep adversarial audit returned NO with four findings, all fixed; a fresh validator returned PASS; 39 tables, 451 rows, zero pipe-count mismatches.

## Links

- Plan: `docs/SPEC_V2.md` — §2 (thesis), §3 (invariants P1–P11), §10.1–§10.5 (ownership, seams, actions, UI), §12 (slices), §15 (decisions and open questions).
- Issue: #24; branch `issue/24-spec-v2-landing` (HEAD `c3b363b4`); the seed row `SPEC-V2`, tranche 0.
- Design pack: `docs/design/` — the public programme site at `/design/` and the reviewed reference.

## Notes

Reconstructed from the project record on 2026-11-28 for standard v4. The reviewed landing was docs-only; later units revise the live plan (D67, D68), and those revisions are their record, not #24's acceptance.

# Acceptance criteria — SPEC V2 — the organisational operating model

## Scenarios

- The V2 model lands as exactly one file, `docs/SPEC_V2.md`, with no code, schema, config, CI or migration change.
- The document carries 18 top-level sections: §1–§15 and Appendices A–C.
- §15.1 carries D56–D60 with their rulings; §15.2 carries open questions 17–20 with an owner each.
- Markdown integrity holds: 39 tables, 451 rows, zero pipe-count mismatches.
- The review record holds: a deep adversarial audit returned NO with four findings, all fixed; a fresh validator returned PASS.
- §12 defines the T-slice set — T0–T19 plus the T19F follow-on — with a gate per slice and typed dependencies; T0–T3 plus T13 are the first three months, and T12 is the one-organisation-loop acceptance.
- The thesis names exactly four units — job, card, approval, run — and states invariants P1–P11 with an enforcement per principle.
- Every action family in §10.4 is an `ActionSpec`: one declaration → HTTP + MCP + OpenAPI + generated client.
- The design pack remains the public programme site and reviewed reference; the real UI is the app, and no production screen renders a fixture (D64).
- #24 is closed by one PR whose body carries a `Closes` line naming it, and the branch `issue/24-spec-v2-landing` is deleted.

## Verify commands

- `git show origin/main:docs/SPEC_V2.md | grep -c '^## '` → 18.
- `git show origin/main:docs/SPEC_V2.md | grep -cE 'D5[6-9]|D60'` ≥ 5.
- `git show origin/main:docs/SPEC_V2.md | sed -n '/^## 15\./,/^## Appendix A/p' | grep -cE '\b(17|18|19|20)\b'` ≥ 4.
- The reviewed blob `c5567f8` measured 1,538 lines (issue #24, measured 2026-11-11).
- The landing PR's file list recorded on #24: one file, `+1538 -0`.
- The landing PR's CI run, and the review verdict recorded on v1 PR #36 (archived).

## Results

met at landing; #24 is CLOSED. The reviewed blob `c5567f8` landed on main through the fresh docs PR from `issue/24-spec-v2-landing` (HEAD `c3b363b4`, the 2026-11-26 session recorded on the issue). The PR changed one file, `+1538 -0`; the deep audit's four findings were fixed before the fresh validator returned PASS. The seed row reads `status: closed`, `measured_status: built`, tranche 0, `plan_status: active` — the document remains the live plan after the project closes. The document has since been revised by later units: it is 2,041 lines in the current tree, still 18 top-level sections, and carries D67 and D68. Those revisions are outside #24's acceptance.

met — the document landed docs-only, the decisions and open questions are recorded, and #24 is closed. A later edit to §15 belongs to the unit that makes it and must re-pin `SPEC_V2_SHA256` or checks-shard reds.

documents.title: Definition of ready — SPEC V2 — the organisational operating model
documents.body:
# Definition of ready — SPEC V2 — the organisational operating model

## Independent

The unit is file-disjoint: one file, `docs/SPEC_V2.md`, docs-only. It changes no crate, schema, config, CI workflow or migration, and it implements no V2 slice or V2 decision — those are separate issues. The seed row carries `depends_on: []`.

## Negotiable

The outcome is fixed — the V2 organisational model adopted, with its decisions and open questions recorded. How the document was reviewed (one adversarial audit, four findings fixed, a fresh validator) and the order that produced it were settled at delivery.

## Valuable

The programme had a delivery queue but no V2 model: jobs, the decision ladder, the tool platform and the T-slice sequence were undefined. The document is the contract the slices cite — it names the four units (job, card, approval, run), the invariants P1–P11 with an enforcement each, the action families, and the gate for every T-slice.

## Estimable

Baseline named with blob shas: `SPEC.md` blob `78a3322`, `00-INDEX.md` blob `7bcc0a1`, `SPEC_V2.md` blob `c5567f8` — 1,538 lines, 18 sections — measured 2026-11-11. The issue's P1–P3 scenarios and their `Verify:` commands are the measured target.

## Small

One document, 1,538 lines, in one file: one issue (#24), one branch `issue/24-spec-v2-landing`, one PR. The work the document defines is deliberately out of scope and is carried by the T-slices, each with its own issue, branch and PR.

## Testable

Each part carries a Given/When/Then with a `Verify:` command: the file list (`+1538 -0`), the section count (18), the §15.1 decision grep (D56–D60), the §15.2 question grep (17–20), and the `Closes` line. Markdown integrity is counted (39 tables, 451 rows, zero pipe-count mismatches), and the review is a recorded verdict, not an opinion.

## Dependencies

- blocked-by: none — the seed row has `depends_on: []`.
- related: #18 — both touch the docs body; #18 reconciles the V1 contradictions, this lands V2. #8 — the deployment gate; V2 does not change the V1 delivery queue.
- blocks: nothing at the seed level; the T-slice set in §12 takes the document as its plan of record, and each slice is a separate issue.

## Links

- The issue's dependency table; `docs/SPEC_V2.md` §12; the seed row `SPEC-V2`.

## Notes

Reconstructed from the project record on 2026-11-28 for standard v4.

# Definition of done — SPEC V2 — the organisational operating model

## Acceptance criteria

| Criterion | Verify |
|---|---|
| One file, `docs/SPEC_V2.md`, docs-only (`+1538 -0`) | the landing PR's file list recorded on #24 |
| 18 top-level sections | the section-count grep, recorded result 18 |
| D56–D60 recorded with their rulings | the §15.1 decision grep, recorded result at least 5 |
| Open questions 17–20 present and owned | the §15.2 question grep, recorded result at least 4 |
| Markdown integrity | the count on v1 PR #36 (archived): 39 tables, 451 rows, zero pipe-count mismatches |
| Review verdict | deep audit NO, four findings all fixed, fresh validator PASS |
| One PR closed #24 with a `Closes` line | #24's closure and the PR body |
| No code, schema, config, CI or migration change | the same file list |

## Evidence at completion

#24 is CLOSED. The reviewed blob `c5567f8` landed on main through the fresh docs PR from `issue/24-spec-v2-landing` (HEAD `c3b363b4`, the 2026-11-26 session recorded on the issue), changing one file, `+1538 -0`. The seed row reads `status: closed`, `measured_status: built`, tranche 0, `plan_status: active`. The acceptance commands for the record:

```text
git show origin/main:docs/SPEC_V2.md | grep -c '^## '
git show origin/main:docs/SPEC_V2.md | grep -cE 'D5[6-9]|D60'
git show origin/main:docs/SPEC_V2.md | sed -n '/^## 15\./,/^## Appendix A/p' | grep -cE '\b(17|18|19|20)\b'
```

The document has since been revised by later units — 2,041 lines in the current tree, still 18 top-level sections, carrying D67 and D68 — and those revisions are not part of this project's completion.

## Repo gate

The landing was docs-only, so the PR's CI is the verdict and no compile is required. The markdown-integrity count (39 tables, 451 rows, zero pipe-count mismatches) is the docs gate recorded at review. Any later edit to `docs/SPEC_V2.md` must re-pin `SPEC_V2_SHA256` or checks-shard reds; that rule applies to the unit that makes the edit, not to #24's merge.

## Merge and closure

One PR merged with a `Closes` line naming #24; #24 closed; the branch `issue/24-spec-v2-landing` deleted; no code, schema, config, CI or migration changed. The pre-issue v1 PR #36 (archived) is history: the adoption added #24 and the Closes line, and the 2026-11-26 fresh PR is the unit's counted merge.

## Links

- `docs/SPEC_V2.md` §12 and §15; #24; the seed row `SPEC-V2`.

## Notes

Reconstructed for standard v4 on 2026-11-28; the project's closed state is the record's.
